properties.description: Starts a Cisco Repository firmware upgrade for one Server, UCS-X Chassis, or IMM Domain, optionally with five bounded polls. It validates exact organization-scoped identity, relationships, catalog tags, model compatibility, UCS-X expander topology, and a Domain Fabric Interconnect A/B pair before mutation. Server SkipEstimateImpact is fixed false. Domain WaitTimeOut is fixed 0. UCS-X XFM behavior is derived from the expanded equipped topology: a healthy UCSX-FS-9516 pair uses partial-shutdown; excluded or absent XFM uses none and an explicit xfm exclusion. Final preflight blocks NONE/IN_PROGRESS but can race create. HTTP 200 means accepted, not complete, unless status is SUCCESSFUL. The workflow supports only Cisco Repository and never accepts repository credentials. Inspect ambiguous or failed results before retrying.

UCS-X values: none, local-disk, psu, xfm. Domain requires empty input. For UCS-X, xfm is added automatically when no healthy equipped XFM pair will be upgraded.

import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
expectedName = sys.argv[2]

    raise ValueError("Organization response is missing a Results array")

    organizationStatus = "not-found"
    organizationMessage = "No exact organization matched Device Organization."
elif len(values) > 1:
    organizationStatus = "ambiguous"
    organizationMessage = "Multiple organizations matched Device Organization."
else:
    item = values[0]
    moid = str(item.get("Moid") or "") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
    if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("Name") != expectedName or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization" or item.get("ClassId") != "organization.Organization" or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", moid):
        organizationStatus = "invalid"
        organizationMessage = "The organization response has an invalid exact name, discriminator, or URL-safe Moid."
    else:
        organizationStatus = "exact"
        organizationMoid = moid
        organizationMessage = "Exactly one organization identity was validated."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"status": organizationStatus, "message": organizationMessage, "organizationMoid": organizationMoid or None}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = organizationStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "exact") and bool(organizationMessage and organizationResultJson) and (organizationStatus != "exact" or bool(organizationMoid))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{24}", value) is not None

def relation_matches(rel, moid, objectType):
    return isinstance(rel, dict) and rel.get("Moid") == moid and rel.get("ObjectType") == objectType and rel.get("ClassId") in (None, "mo.MoRef", objectType)

targetStatus = "invalid"
targetStatusCode = "502"
targetStatusMessage = "Domain Fabric Interconnect lookup failed"
targetErrorMessage = "Domain Fabric Interconnect inspection did not complete."
targetResultJson = json.dumps({"status":targetStatus,"message":targetErrorMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
imageApiUrl = ""
activeUpgradeApiUrl = ""
helperReady = False
try:
    apiSucceeded = str(sys.argv[2]).strip().lower() == "true"
    try:
        apiStatusCode = int(sys.argv[3])
    except Exception:
        apiStatusCode = 0
    provisional = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[5]
    if not isinstance(provisional, dict) or provisional.get("status") != "domain-pending" or provisional.get("targetType") != "Domain":
        raise ValueError("Primary Domain target contract is not domain-pending.")
    targetMoid = provisional.get("targetMoid")
    registeredDeviceMoid = provisional.get("registeredDeviceMoid")
    firmwareVersion = str(provisional.get("firmwareVersion") or "")
    if not safe_moid(targetMoid) or not safe_moid(registeredDeviceMoid) or not safe_moid(organizationMoid) or not firmwareVersion:
        raise ValueError("Primary Domain target identifiers or Firmware Version are invalid.")
    if not apiSucceeded or apiStatusCode != 200:
        targetStatus = "api-failure"
        targetStatusCode = "502"
        targetStatusMessage = "Domain Fabric Interconnect lookup API failed"
        targetErrorMessage = "The organization-scoped network.Element request did not complete with documented HTTP 200."
    else:
        payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
        values = payload.get("Results") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(values, list):
            raise ValueError("Domain Fabric Interconnect response is missing a Results array.")
        if len(values) == 0:
            targetStatus = "not-found"
            targetStatusCode = "404"
            targetStatusMessage = "Domain Fabric Interconnect pair not found"
            targetErrorMessage = "No organization-scoped Fabric Interconnect elements matched the connected Domain RegisteredDevice."
        elif len(values) > 2:
            targetStatus = "ambiguous"
            targetStatusCode = "409"
            targetStatusMessage = "Domain Fabric Interconnect lookup is ambiguous"
            targetErrorMessage = "More than two organization-scoped Fabric Interconnect elements matched the connected Domain RegisteredDevice."
        elif len(values) != 2:
            targetStatus = "invalid"
            targetStatusCode = "409"
            targetStatusMessage = "Domain Fabric Interconnect pair is incomplete"
            targetErrorMessage = "A connected IMM Domain must resolve exactly two Fabric Interconnect elements."
        else:
            problems = []
            seenMoids = set()
            seenSwitchIds = set()
            networkElements = []
            for element in values:
                if not isinstance(element, dict):
                    problems.append("Every Domain Fabric Interconnect result must be an object.")
                    continue
                moid = element.get("Moid")
                switchId = element.get("SwitchId")
                model = element.get("Model")
                permissions = element.get("PermissionResources")
                organizationMatches = [rel for rel in permissions if relation_matches(rel, organizationMoid, "organization.Organization")] if isinstance(permissions, list) else []
                if not safe_moid(moid) or moid in seenMoids:
                    problems.append("Domain Fabric Interconnects must have two distinct concrete Moids.")
                if element.get("ObjectType") != "network.Element" or element.get("ClassId") != "network.Element":
                    problems.append("Domain Fabric Interconnect discriminators are invalid.")
                if element.get("SwitchType") != "FabricInterconnect":
                    problems.append("Both Domain network elements must be FabricInterconnect.")
                if switchId not in ("A", "B") or switchId in seenSwitchIds:
                    problems.append("Domain Fabric Interconnects must identify distinct fabric A and B.")
                if not isinstance(model, str) or not model:
                    problems.append("Each Domain Fabric Interconnect requires Model for catalog compatibility.")
                if not relation_matches(element.get("RegisteredDevice"), registeredDeviceMoid, "asset.DeviceRegistration"):
                    problems.append("Each Domain Fabric Interconnect must relate to the validated RegisteredDevice.")
                if len(organizationMatches) != 1:
                    problems.append("Each Domain Fabric Interconnect must contain exactly one matching organization relationship.")
                seenMoids.add(moid)
                seenSwitchIds.add(switchId)
                networkElements.append({"Moid":moid,"Model":model,"SwitchId":switchId,"SwitchType":"FabricInterconnect","ObjectType":"network.Element","ClassId":"network.Element"})
            if seenSwitchIds != {"A", "B"}:
                problems.append("Domain must contain exactly fabric A and fabric B.")
            if problems:
                targetStatus = "invalid"
                targetStatusCode = "409"
                targetStatusMessage = "Domain Fabric Interconnect identity conflict"
                targetErrorMessage = " ".join(problems)
            else:
                networkElements = sorted(networkElements, key=lambda value: value["SwitchId"])
                escapedFirmwareVersion = firmwareVersion.replace("'", "''")
                imageApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/Distributables?$filter=Version eq '" + escapedFirmwareVersion + "'&$select=Moid,Version,Model,SupportedModels,ImageType,PlatformType,Vendor,Origin,ObjectType,ClassId,Tags"
                activeUpgradeApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/SwitchUpgrades?$filter=NetworkElements/any(n:n/Moid eq '" + networkElements[0]["Moid"] + "') and NetworkElements/any(n:n/Moid eq '" + networkElements[1]["Moid"] + "') and (Status eq 'NONE' or Status eq 'IN_PROGRESS')&$top=2&$select=Moid,Status,ObjectType,ClassId,NetworkElements"
                finalResult = dict(provisional)
                finalResult.update({"status":"exact","message":"Connected IMM Domain and exact Fabric Interconnect A/B pair were validated.","targetModel":",".join(element["Model"] for element in networkElements),"distributableType":"IMMFABRIC","networkElements":networkElements,"activeUpgradeApiUrl":activeUpgradeApiUrl,"imageObjectType":"firmware.Distributable"})
                targetStatus = "exact"
                targetStatusCode = "200"
                targetStatusMessage = "Domain Fabric Interconnect pair validated"
                targetErrorMessage = ""
                targetResultJson = json.dumps(finalResult, separators=(",",":"))
    if targetStatus != "exact":
        failureResult = dict(provisional)
        failureResult.update({"status":targetStatus,"message":targetErrorMessage,"networkElements":[]})
        targetResultJson = json.dumps(failureResult, separators=(",",":"))
    helperReady = targetStatus in ("api-failure","not-found","ambiguous","invalid","exact") and bool(targetStatusCode and targetStatusMessage and targetResultJson) and (targetStatus != "exact" or bool(imageApiUrl and activeUpgradeApiUrl))
except Exception as exc:
    targetStatus = "invalid"
    targetStatusCode = "502"
    targetStatusMessage = "Domain Fabric Interconnect response is invalid"
    targetErrorMessage = str(exc)
    targetResultJson = json.dumps({"status":targetStatus,"message":targetErrorMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
    helperReady = bool(targetErrorMessage and targetResultJson)

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
target = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
prepared = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
values = payload.get("Results") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
if not isinstance(values, list):
    raise ValueError("Firmware image response is missing a Results array.")

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{24}", value) is not None

def tag_pairs(item):
    tags = item.get("Tags")
    if not isinstance(tags, list):
        return set()
    return {(tag.get("Key"), tag.get("Value")) for tag in tags if isinstance(tag, dict)}

def models_match(item, required):
    supported = item.get("SupportedModels")
    supported = supported if isinstance(supported, list) else []
    catalog_model = item.get("Model")
    return bool(required) and all(isinstance(model, str) and model and (catalog_model == model or model in supported) for model in required)

target_type = prepared.get("targetType")
version = prepared.get("firmwareVersion")
target_moid = target.get("targetMoid")
compatible = []
schema_problems = []
for index, item in enumerate(values):
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        schema_problems.append("Catalog result " + str(index) + " is not an object.")
        continue
    if not safe_moid(item.get("Moid")):
        schema_problems.append("Catalog result " + str(index) + " has an invalid Moid.")
        continue
    if item.get("Version") != version:
        schema_problems.append("Catalog result " + str(index) + " does not exactly match Firmware Version.")
        continue
    if item.get("ObjectType") != "firmware.Distributable" or item.get("ClassId") != "firmware.Distributable":
        schema_problems.append("Catalog result " + str(index) + " is not a concrete firmware.Distributable.")
        continue
    pairs = tag_pairs(item)
    if ("cisco.meta.repositorytype", "IntersightCloud") not in pairs:
        continue
    if target_type == "Server":
        required_models = [target.get("targetModel")]
        required_type = target.get("distributableType")
        if ("cisco.meta.distributabletype", required_type) in pairs and models_match(item, required_models):
            compatible.append(item)
    elif target_type == "UCS-X Chassis":
        if ("cisco.meta.distributabletype", "IMMFABRIC") in pairs and models_match(item, [target.get("targetModel")]):
            compatible.append(item)
    elif target_type == "Domain":
        elements = target.get("networkElements")
        required_models = [entry.get("Model") for entry in elements if isinstance(entry, dict)] if isinstance(elements, list) else []
        if len(required_models) == 2 and ("cisco.meta.distributabletype", "IMMFABRIC") in pairs and models_match(item, required_models):
            compatible.append(item)
    else:
        schema_problems.append("Unsupported target route reached the image builder.")

image_moid = ""
image_object_type = ""
request_json = ""
submit_api_url = ""
created_resource_url = ""
submit_object_type = ""
if schema_problems:
    image_status = "invalid"
    image_message = " ".join(schema_problems)
elif len(compatible) == 0:
    image_status = "not-found"
    if target_type == "Server":
        image_message = "No exact version/model Cisco cloud Distributable matched the required server distributable type."
    elif target_type == "UCS-X Chassis":
        image_message = "No exact version/model Cisco cloud Distributable matched the validated UCS-X chassis."
    else:
        image_message = "No exact IMMFABRIC/IntersightCloud Distributable supported both validated Domain Fabric Interconnect models."
elif len(compatible) > 1:
    image_status = "ambiguous"
    image_message = "Multiple compatible Cisco firmware Distributables matched the exact requested version and target contract."
else:
    image = compatible[0]
    image_status = "exact"
    image_message = "Exactly one compatible Cisco repository firmware Distributable was validated."
    image_moid = image["Moid"]
    image_object_type = "firmware.Distributable"
    direct_download = {"ObjectType":"firmware.DirectDownload","ClassId":"firmware.DirectDownload","ImageSource":"cisco"}
    image_ref = {"Moid":image_moid,"ObjectType":"firmware.Distributable","ClassId":"mo.MoRef"}
    if target_type == "Server":
        submit_object_type = "firmware.Upgrade"
        submit_api_url = "/api/v1/firmware/Upgrades"
        direct_download["Upgradeoption"] = "upgrade_full" if prepared.get("serverUpgradeMode") == "Start Immediately" else "upgrade_mount_only"
        request = {
            "ObjectType":submit_object_type,
            "ClassId":submit_object_type,
            "UpgradeType":"direct_upgrade",
            "DirectDownload":direct_download,
            "Distributable":image_ref,
            "Server":{"Moid":target_moid,"ObjectType":target.get("sourceObjectType"),"ClassId":"mo.MoRef"},
            "SkipEstimateImpact":False
        }
        exclusions = prepared.get("excludedComponents")
        if isinstance(exclusions, list) and exclusions:
            request["ExcludeComponentList"] = exclusions
        pid_object = prepared.get("excludedComponentPids")
        if isinstance(pid_object, dict) and pid_object:
            typed_pid = {"ObjectType":"firmware.ExcludeComponentPidListType","ClassId":"firmware.ExcludeComponentPidListType"}
            for key in ("ExcludeLocalDiskList", "ExcludeStorageControllerList"):
                if key in pid_object:
                    typed_pid[key] = pid_object[key]
            request["ExcludeComponentPidList"] = typed_pid
    elif target_type == "UCS-X Chassis":
        submit_object_type = "firmware.ChassisUpgrade"
        submit_api_url = "/api/v1/firmware/ChassisUpgrades"
        direct_download["Upgradeoption"] = "upgrade_full"
        exclusions = target.get("excludedComponents")
        xfm_option = target.get("xfmUpgradeOption")
        topology = target.get("xfmTopology")
        if xfm_option not in ("none", "partial-shutdown") or not isinstance(exclusions, list):
            raise ValueError("Validated UCS-X XFM contract is incomplete.")
        if xfm_option == "partial-shutdown" and ("xfm" in exclusions or not isinstance(topology, dict) or topology.get("healthyPair") is not True):
            raise ValueError("partial-shutdown requires the validated healthy UCSX-FS-9516 pair and no xfm exclusion.")
        if xfm_option == "none" and "xfm" not in exclusions:
            raise ValueError("A non-upgraded XFM topology must explicitly exclude xfm.")
        request = {
            "ObjectType":submit_object_type,
            "ClassId":submit_object_type,
            "UpgradeType":"direct_upgrade",
            "DirectDownload":direct_download,
            "Distributable":image_ref,
            "Chassis":{"Moid":target_moid,"ObjectType":"equipment.Chassis","ClassId":"mo.MoRef"},
            "XfmUpgradeOption":xfm_option,
            "ExcludeComponentList":exclusions
        }
    else:
        submit_object_type = "firmware.SwitchUpgrade"
        submit_api_url = "/api/v1/firmware/SwitchUpgrades"
        direct_download["Upgradeoption"] = "sd_upgrade_only"
        elements = target.get("networkElements")
        if not isinstance(elements, list) or len(elements) != 2:
            raise ValueError("Validated Domain Fabric Interconnect pair is incomplete.")
        network_refs = [{"Moid":entry["Moid"],"ObjectType":"network.Element","ClassId":"mo.MoRef"} for entry in elements]
        request = {
            "ObjectType":submit_object_type,
            "ClassId":submit_object_type,
            "UpgradeType":"direct_upgrade",
            "DirectDownload":direct_download,
            "Distributable":image_ref,
            "NetworkElements":network_refs,
            "EnableFabricEvacuation":bool(prepared.get("enableFabricEvacuation")),
            "WaitTimeOut":0,
            "EnablePsuUpgrade":bool(prepared.get("enablePsuUpgrade")),
            "EnablePdbFpgaUpgrade":bool(prepared.get("enablePdbFpgaUpgrade")),
            "SkipWaitForIoPathConnectivity":bool(prepared.get("skipWaitForIoPathConnectivity"))
        }
    created_resource_url = submit_api_url
    request_json = json.dumps(request, separators=(",", ":"))

readiness_caveats = target.get("readinessCaveats") if isinstance(target.get("readinessCaveats"), list) else []
image_result_json = json.dumps({
    "status":image_status,
    "message":image_message,
    "targetType":target_type,
    "firmwareVersion":version,
    "imageMoid":image_moid or None,
    "imageObjectType":image_object_type or None,
    "compatibleCandidateCount":len(compatible),
    "submittedImageField":"Distributable" if image_status == "exact" else None,
    "releaseAbsent":image_status == "exact",
    "switchWaitTimeOutFixedAtZero":target_type == "Domain" and image_status == "exact",
    "serverSkipEstimateImpactFixedFalse":target_type == "Server" and image_status == "exact",
    "ciscoRepositoryOnly":True,
    "readinessCaveats":readiness_caveats
}, separators=(",", ":"))
imageStatus = image_status
imageMessage = image_message
imageResultJson = image_result_json
imageMoid = image_moid
imageObjectType = image_object_type
requestJson = request_json
submitApiUrl = submit_api_url
createdResourceUrl = created_resource_url
submitObjectType = submit_object_type
helperReady = image_status in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "exact") and bool(image_message and image_result_json) and (image_status != "exact" or bool(image_moid and image_object_type and request_json and submit_api_url and created_resource_url and submit_object_type))

properties.description: Requires documented POST HTTP 200, the exact concrete created-resource identity, target relationships, a matching firmware.Distributable relationship with Release absent, documented uppercase Status, and a validated polling identity.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
status_code = int(sys.argv[2])
target = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
image = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
prepared = json.loads(sys.argv[5])
submit_object_type = sys.argv[6]
image_moid = sys.argv[7]
image_object_type = sys.argv[8]
created_collection = sys.argv[9]
preflight = json.loads(sys.argv[10])

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{24}", value) is not None

def relation_matches(rel, moid, object_type):
    return isinstance(rel, dict) and rel.get("Moid") == moid and rel.get("ObjectType") == object_type and rel.get("ClassId") in (None, "mo.MoRef", object_type)

problems = []
created_moid = ""
upgrade_status_moid = ""
poll_mode = ""
poll_api_url = ""
poll_moid = ""
target_type = prepared.get("targetType")
expected_submit_type = {"Server":"firmware.Upgrade","UCS-X Chassis":"firmware.ChassisUpgrade","Domain":"firmware.SwitchUpgrade"}.get(target_type)
expected_collection = {"Server":"/api/v1/firmware/Upgrades","UCS-X Chassis":"/api/v1/firmware/ChassisUpgrades","Domain":"/api/v1/firmware/SwitchUpgrades"}.get(target_type)
if status_code != 200:
    problems.append("Firmware create response status is not documented HTTP 200.")
if submit_object_type != expected_submit_type or created_collection != expected_collection:
    problems.append("Submission type or created-resource collection does not match the validated target route.")
if not safe_moid(image_moid) or image_object_type != "firmware.Distributable" or image.get("imageMoid") != image_moid or image.get("imageObjectType") != "firmware.Distributable":
    problems.append("Validated firmware.Distributable identity is incomplete or inconsistent.")
if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    problems.append("Firmware create response is not an object.")
else:
    created_moid = str(payload.get("Moid") or "")
    if not safe_moid(created_moid):
        problems.append("Created firmware resource Moid is missing or invalid.")
    if payload.get("ObjectType") != submit_object_type or payload.get("ClassId") != submit_object_type:
        problems.append("Created firmware resource discriminators do not match the submitted concrete type.")
    if target_type == "Server":
        if not relation_matches(payload.get("Server"), target.get("targetMoid"), target.get("sourceObjectType")):
            problems.append("Returned Server relationship does not match the validated target.")
    elif target_type == "UCS-X Chassis":
        if not relation_matches(payload.get("Chassis"), target.get("targetMoid"), "equipment.Chassis"):
            problems.append("Returned Chassis relationship does not match the validated UCS-X target.")
    elif target_type == "Domain":
        returned = payload.get("NetworkElements")
        expected = {entry.get("Moid") for entry in target.get("networkElements", []) if isinstance(entry, dict)}
        returned_moids = {entry.get("Moid") for entry in returned if isinstance(entry, dict) and relation_matches(entry, entry.get("Moid"), "network.Element")} if isinstance(returned, list) else set()
        if len(expected) != 2 or not isinstance(returned, list) or len(returned) != 2 or returned_moids != expected:
            problems.append("Returned NetworkElements do not exactly match the validated Domain FI A/B pair.")
    else:
        problems.append("Unsupported target route reached submission inspection.")
    if not relation_matches(payload.get("Distributable"), image_moid, "firmware.Distributable"):
        problems.append("Returned Distributable relationship does not match the validated image.")
    if payload.get("Release") not in (None, {}):
        problems.append("Returned firmware resource unexpectedly contains Release.")
    status = payload.get("Status")
    if status not in ("NONE", "IN_PROGRESS", "SUCCESSFUL", "FAILED", "TERMINATED"):
        problems.append("Created firmware resource Status is not a documented uppercase enum.")
    upgrade_status = payload.get("UpgradeStatus")
    if upgrade_status not in (None, {}):
        if not isinstance(upgrade_status, dict) or not safe_moid(upgrade_status.get("Moid")) or upgrade_status.get("ObjectType") != "firmware.UpgradeStatus" or upgrade_status.get("ClassId") not in (None, "mo.MoRef", "firmware.UpgradeStatus"):
            problems.append("UpgradeStatus relationship is malformed.")
        else:
            upgrade_status_moid = upgrade_status["Moid"]

if problems:
    submission_status = "invalid"
    submission_message = " ".join(problems)
elif payload.get("Status") in ("FAILED", "TERMINATED"):
    submission_status = "failed"
    submission_message = "The firmware resource was created but immediately returned terminal Status " + payload.get("Status") + "."
elif payload.get("Status") == "SUCCESSFUL":
    submission_status = "completed"
    submission_message = "The firmware resource was created and already reports Status SUCCESSFUL."
else:
    submission_status = "accepted"
    submission_message = "The firmware upgrade resource was accepted with documented HTTP 200; completion is not yet confirmed."

if submission_status in ("accepted", "completed", "failed"):
    if upgrade_status_moid:
        poll_mode = "upgrade-status"
        poll_api_url = "/api/v1/firmware/UpgradeStatuses/" + upgrade_status_moid
        poll_moid = upgrade_status_moid
    else:
        poll_mode = "created-resource"
        poll_api_url = created_collection + "/" + created_moid
        poll_moid = created_moid

submission_result_json = json.dumps({
    "status":submission_status,
    "message":submission_message,
    "requestAccepted":status_code == 200,
    "completed":submission_status == "completed",
    "targetType":target_type,
    "targetName":target.get("targetName"),
    "targetMoid":target.get("targetMoid"),
    "imageMoid":image_moid,
    "imageObjectType":image_object_type,
    "createdMoid":created_moid or None,
    "createdObjectType":submit_object_type,
    "upgradeStatusMoid":upgrade_status_moid or None,
    "pollMode":poll_mode or None,
    "waitRequested":bool(prepared.get("waitForCompletion")),
    "acceptedVersusCompletedSemantics":True,
    "releaseAbsent":payload.get("Release") in (None, {}) if isinstance(payload, dict) else False,
    "retryRequiresInspection":submission_status in ("invalid", "failed"),
    "readinessCaveats":target.get("readinessCaveats", []),
    "preflight":preflight
}, separators=(",", ":"))
inspection_required_result = json.loads(submission_result_json)
inspection_required_result.update({
    "status":"inspection-required",
    "message":"The firmware upgrade request was accepted, but subsequent orchestration failed. Inspect the tracked firmware resource before retrying.",
    "requestAccepted":True,
    "completed":False,
    "retryRequiresInspection":True
})
submission_inspection_required_result_json = json.dumps(inspection_required_result, separators=(",", ":"))
submissionStatus = submission_status
submissionMessage = submission_message
submissionResultJson = submission_result_json
submissionInspectionRequiredResultJson = submission_inspection_required_result_json
pollMode = poll_mode
pollApiUrl = poll_api_url
pollMoid = poll_moid
helperReady = submission_status in ("invalid", "failed", "accepted", "completed") and bool(submission_message and submission_result_json and submission_inspection_required_result_json) and (submission_status == "invalid" or bool(created_moid and poll_mode and poll_api_url and poll_moid))

properties.description: Creates one deadline and safe delays for exactly five poll attempts within the user-supplied 1-600 second bound; each delay stays below the 180-second helper timeout.
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time
timeout = int(sys.argv[1])
if timeout < 1 or timeout > 600:
    raise ValueError("Wait timeout must be between 1 and 600 seconds")
now = time.time()
initialDelay = min(2.0, max(0.25, timeout / 20.0))
pollInterval = max(1.0, max(0.0, timeout - initialDelay) / 4.0)
if initialDelay >= 180.0 or pollInterval >= 180.0:
    raise ValueError("Derived delays exceed the helper action timeout")
deadlineEpoch = "%.6f" % (now + timeout)
initialDelaySeconds = "%.6f" % initialDelay
pollIntervalSeconds = "%.6f" % pollInterval
pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"waitTimeoutSeconds": timeout, "initialDelaySeconds": initialDelay, "pollIntervalSeconds": pollInterval, "maximumPollAttempts": 5}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = bool(deadlineEpoch and initialDelaySeconds and pollIntervalSeconds and pollingResultJson)

actions.title: Wait before firmware upgrade polling attempt

properties.description: Uses the initial delay for attempt 1 and the shared interval for attempts 2-5, never sleeping past the validated firmware upgrade deadline.
properties.display_name: Wait before firmware upgrade polling attempt
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
initialDelay = float(sys.argv[2])
pollInterval = float(sys.argv[3])
attempt = int(sys.argv[4])
submission = json.loads(sys.argv[5])
if attempt < 1 or attempt > 5:
    raise ValueError("Polling attempt must be from 1 through 5")
if not isinstance(submission, dict) or submission.get("requestAccepted") is not True:
    raise ValueError("Validated accepted submission contract is required")
preservedKeys = (
    "targetType",
    "targetName",
    "targetMoid",
    "imageMoid",
    "imageObjectType",
    "createdMoid",
    "createdObjectType",
    "upgradeStatusMoid",
    "pollMode",
    "readinessCaveats",
    "retryRequiresInspection"
)
if any(key not in submission for key in preservedKeys):
    raise ValueError("Accepted submission contract is missing terminal identity fields")
requestedDelay = initialDelay if attempt == 1 else pollInterval
if requestedDelay < 0 or requestedDelay >= 180:
    raise ValueError("Polling delay is outside safe helper bound")
stage = "firmware upgrade poll " + str(attempt)
remaining = deadline - time.time()
if remaining <= 0:
    waitStatus = "timeout"
    waitMessage = "The firmware upgrade wait deadline was reached before " + stage + "."
    timeoutResult = {key: submission.get(key) for key in preservedKeys}
    timeoutResult.update({
        "requestAccepted": True,
        "completed": False,
        "timeout": True,
        "stage": stage,
        "attempt": attempt
    })
    waitResultJson = json.dumps(timeoutResult, separators=(",", ":"))
else:
    actualDelay = min(requestedDelay, remaining)
    time.sleep(actualDelay)
    waitStatus = "ready"
    waitMessage = "The bounded delay before " + stage + " completed."
    waitResultJson = json.dumps({"stage":stage,"attempt":attempt,"requestedDelaySeconds":requestedDelay,"actualDelaySeconds":actualDelay}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = waitStatus in ("ready", "timeout") and bool(waitMessage and waitResultJson)

properties.description: Validates identity, documented terminal states, and response consistency for the current firmware upgrade poll.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
statusCode = int(sys.argv[2])
pollMode = sys.argv[3]
expectedMoid = sys.argv[4]
submitObjectType = sys.argv[5]
submission = json.loads(sys.argv[6])
attempt = int(sys.argv[7])

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None

problems = []
observedStatus = ""
if statusCode != 200:
    problems.append("Poll response status is not documented HTTP 200.")
if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    problems.append("Poll response is not an object.")
elif payload.get("Moid") != expectedMoid or not safe_moid(payload.get("Moid")):
    problems.append("Poll response Moid does not match the exact tracked resource.")
elif pollMode == "upgrade-status":
    if payload.get("ObjectType") != "firmware.UpgradeStatus" or payload.get("ClassId") != "firmware.UpgradeStatus":
        problems.append("UpgradeStatus poll discriminators are invalid.")
    observedStatus = payload.get("Overallstatus")
    allowed = {"none", "started", "prepare initiating", "prepare initiated", "prepared", "download initiating", "download initiated", "downloading", "downloaded", "upgrade initiating on fabric A", "upgrade initiated on fabric A", "upgrading fabric A", "rebooting fabric A", "upgraded fabric A", "upgrade initiating on fabric B", "upgrade initiated on fabric B", "upgrading fabric B", "rebooting fabric B", "upgraded fabric B", "upgrade initiating", "upgrade initiated", "upgrading", "oob images staging", "oob images staged", "rebooting", "upgraded", "success", "failed", "terminated", "pending", "ReadyForCache", "Caching", "Cached", "CachingFailed"}
    if observedStatus not in allowed:
        problems.append("UpgradeStatus Overallstatus is not a documented enum.")
elif pollMode == "created-resource":
    if payload.get("ObjectType") != submitObjectType or payload.get("ClassId") != submitObjectType:
        problems.append("Created-resource poll discriminators are invalid.")
    observedStatus = payload.get("Status")
    if observedStatus not in ("NONE", "IN_PROGRESS", "SUCCESSFUL", "FAILED", "TERMINATED"):
        problems.append("Created-resource Status is not a documented uppercase enum.")
else:
    problems.append("Poll mode is invalid.")

if problems:
    pollStatus = "invalid"
    pollMessage = " ".join(problems)
elif (pollMode == "upgrade-status" and observedStatus == "success") or (pollMode == "created-resource" and observedStatus == "SUCCESSFUL"):
    pollStatus = "completed"
    pollMessage = "Firmware upgrade completion was confirmed by the exact tracked resource."
elif (pollMode == "upgrade-status" and observedStatus in ("failed", "terminated", "CachingFailed")) or (pollMode == "created-resource" and observedStatus in ("FAILED", "TERMINATED")):
    pollStatus = "failed"
    pollMessage = "The exact tracked firmware resource reported terminal failure state " + str(observedStatus) + "."
else:
    pollStatus = "in-progress"
    pollMessage = "The exact tracked firmware resource remains nonterminal at attempt " + str(attempt) + "."

pollResultJson = json.dumps({
    "status": pollStatus,
    "message": pollMessage,
    "requestAccepted": True,
    "completed": pollStatus == "completed",
    "attempt": attempt,
    "maximumPollAttempts": 5,
    "pollMode": pollMode,
    "trackedMoid": expectedMoid,
    "observedStatus": observedStatus or None,
    "createdMoid": submission.get("createdMoid"),
    "createdObjectType": submission.get("createdObjectType"),
    "targetType": submission.get("targetType"),
    "targetMoid": submission.get("targetMoid"),
    "imageMoid": submission.get("imageMoid"),
    "readinessCaveats": submission.get("readinessCaveats", []),
    "retryRequiresInspection": pollStatus in ("invalid", "failed")
}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = pollStatus in ("invalid", "failed", "completed", "in-progress") and bool(pollMessage and pollResultJson)
pollTerminalMessage = "Firmware status response failed validation" if pollStatus == "invalid" else "Firmware upgrade reported terminal failure" if pollStatus == "failed" else pollMessage
